title: Multiple Bindings with let
description: Use let to bind multiple names in one form, then compute with those bindings in the body.

steps.description: Reveal the complete let expression with two bindings and the computation.
Focus on bindings: a bound to 3, b bound to 4 in a list of pairs.

steps.question: What does (* a a) compute when a is 3?

steps.description: Focus on body: (+ (* a a) (* b b)) computes a squared plus b squared.
Run to show the let expression.
